name: Duck Flight
shortDescription: Fly as a duck in first-person through a world of oncoming rings. Steer left and right to thread each ring — miss too many and your momentum crashes.

suggestion.prompt: Build a single-file HTML5 game, Duck Flight. Mobile-first, 1st-person through-the-eyes-of-a-duck flying experience. Rings spawn far away and approach the camera. Player steers the duck left/right to thread through ring centers. Momentum system: starts at 1.0, drains passively, drops on miss, rises on good pass — hit zero and it's game over. First-person duck silhouette: beak tip and flapping wings at bottom. 3D perspective projection with fog. Score on leaderboard.

generation.notes: Scaffold build — full architecture laid down for future improvement iterations. 3D perspective projection with FOCAL_LEN=300, VP_Y at 44% height. Rings approach from SPAWN_Z=3000 at 900 units/sec base, speed scales with momentum. Duck steers laterally in world range -1.6 to +1.6. Momentum system wired (passive drain, +0.12 pass, -0.22 miss). Particle system, audio stub, and animation stub all scaffolded with named module objects. Difficulty scaler increases speed +90 and tightens interval -0.15 every 30s. maxScore=500 reflects typical good-run ceiling for the scaffold difficulty.

improvements.description: Refined projection (FOCAL_LEN 300→2000), moved horizon to true vertical center, added animated 3-band cloud sky with cached gradient, rebuilt ground with proper perspective grid, implemented fog color blending (z=40 clear to z=120 fogged via lerpColor toward horizon tone), and added devicePixelRatio canvas scaling.

Rebuilt first-person duck POV: 3-layer bezier wings (primary/secondary/covert feathers with per-layer gradients), off-yellow beak hint at bottom edge, idle bob and flap animations, bank animation driven by damped duck.vx, wing-tip motion blur on hard banking; flap rate scales with momentum.

Replaced fixed ring-only shapes with 3 types (ring, triangle, square); each shape carries size, per-shape innerR, HSL hue, spinAxis (z=face-on twirl, y=barrel-roll), rotationSpeed, and rotation; rendering uses projected polygon vertices with a top-light gradient fill and specular highlight stroke clipped to the upper half; back-to-front sort preserved.

Wired gameplay feel: forward speed now scales directly with momentum (speed=currentSpeed*momentum), difficulty ramps every 10 passes (not time-based) with speed increase+spawn tightening+opening shrink, and game over uses a STALLING state with 0.75s slow-mo + screen darkening before showing the overlay.

Golden-hour visual pass: sky replaced with deep teal-blue zenith to warm peach-gold horizon palette (60s color cycle shifts to dusk); sun disc with wide radial bloom and lens-flare streaks when steering toward it; ground updated to warm sand-to-umber; fog range tightened so distant shapes desaturate and lift lightness toward horizon; edge vignette added.

Juice pass: pass-through burst upgraded to 28 glowing+stretching particles; near-miss sparkle trail (200ms) when in outer ring; speed lines radiating from VP at high momentum; pulsing red stall-warning vignette below 30% momentum with slower wing flap; GAMEOVER screen shake + particle drift + fog deepening; floating +10 score popups on each clear.

Canvas-only UI overhaul: removed DOM #overlay; MENU state shows animated world background with hovering duck silhouette (flapping wings, body, beak), 'DUCK FLIGHT' title with gold glow, subtitle, and persisted best score; HUD redesigned to large outlined score numerals (top-left) + thin centered momentum bar (green-amber-red, pulses below 30%); GAMEOVER state renders dimmed world, red 'GAME OVER', large final score, best score, and pulsing 'Tap to retry'; best score persisted to localStorage; tap/Space/Enter start/retry from canvas; main loop runs continuously from boot.

Mobile polish and performance final pass: DPR capped at 2 for retina performance; touch-action: none on #game-wrap and canvas; touchstart preventDefault with passive: false; visibilitychange handler pauses/resumes loop with lastTime reset to prevent dt spike; haptics via navigator.vibrate (10ms on pass-through, 60ms on game over); input state cleared on tab hide; drawShapes() sort in-place (no per-frame array allocation); DUCK_ACCEL 4.2→5.0 for snappier mobile steering; MOMENTUM_DRAIN -0.012→-0.010 for slightly more forgiving passive drain.
Slowed Duck Flight pacing by reducing base speed, closer and less frequent shape spawns, earlier fog visibility, lower pass/kill thresholds, and gentler difficulty speed ramp.
Replaced constant steering friction with thrust plus proportional drag, expanded lateral range, and capped lateral velocity for more readable inertia and reversal timing.
Amplified Duck Flight banking with a slower spring, larger velocity-driven bank target, stronger wing tilt, and rolled world geometry during banks.
Added gameplay-speed ground scrolling so Duck Flight horizontal grid lines stream toward the player instead of staying static.

Moved fly-through detection from PASS_Z=60 to PASS_Z=28 (shapes fill viewport at check time for genuine fly-through feel), lowered KILL_Z to 10, removed momentum multiplier from forward speed so shapes approach at constant speed, lowered BASE_SPEED from 130 to 100 and ramp cap from 280 to 220.

Added flappy-bird vertical flight mechanic: duck has gravity (5.5 units/sec²) and tap/Space applies an upward flap impulse (3.8 units/sec). Altitude replaces passive momentum drain as primary survival mechanic — hitting the ground crashes the duck. Pass check now uses duck.wy for vertical alignment. project() camera height tracks duck altitude. Altitude bar added on right canvas edge (green=high, red=low, danger zone marked). Tap-to-flap hint fades in first 4 seconds.
Decoupled mobile touch input into left steer, center flap, and right steer zones, raised the starting altitude, and added a short opening grace period with matching first-run input hints.
Added a target-assist HUD with center bullseye and altitude marker, plus an Easy Mode toggle that disables steering and centers all shapes horizontally.

Gentler flap physics: FLAP_VELOCITY reduced 3.8→2.4, GRAVITY reduced 5.5→3.5, and tap impulse changed from hard overwrite to additive-capped (duck.vy = Math.min(FLAP_VELOCITY, duck.vy + FLAP_VELOCITY * 0.75)) so corrections are proportional to current state — tapping while falling gives incremental lift, tapping while level gives a modest boost, tapping while rising caps cleanly without overshoot.

Removed the target-altitude marker (horizontal line + left-pointing triangle) from the elevation bar — it was too revealing. Added four directional arrowheads to the bullseye crosshair: each arm shows a filled triangle pointing toward the target when the duck is off-axis on that dimension (dx/dy > 25% of the shape opening radius); both axes can show simultaneously; arrows disappear and 'ON TARGET' text appears when fully aligned.
